summary: Classifies Nile priority controls and enforces the Priority 1 metadata requirement that planned Azure resources carry required tags and planned GCP resources carry required labels as defined by the Tagging and Labeling Standard.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). Policies read resource_changes[].change.after tags and labels.

controls.title: Priority 1 metadata must be present on planned Azure and GCP resources
controls.source_section: Section 5 – Priority 1 Controls; Section 9 – Priority by Cloud
controls.obligation: Production-priority metadata controls require Nile-managed resources to carry the required Azure tags or GCP labels defined in the Tagging and Labeling Standard.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_* create/update resources, require all mandatory tags in change.after.tags. For google_* create/update resources, require all mandatory labels in change.after.labels, google_container_cluster.after.resource_labels, google_container_node_pool.after.node_config[].labels, and google_sql_database_instance.after.settings[].user_labels.

controls.title: Priority controls guide approval, exception, and validation emphasis
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Relationship to Project Nile; Section 10 – Priority and Exceptions; Section 11 – Priority and Validation
controls.obligation: Priority affects human review, exception risk weighting, and validation emphasis but does not itself prove implementation or replace required approval workflows.
controls.iac_check: Not directly checkable from Terraform plan JSON because it describes governance process and human decision authority.

controls.title: Candidate and TBD priority controls are informational until promoted
controls.source_section: Section 8 – Priority 4 Controls; Section 12 – Governance Agent Guidance; Section 13 – Validation Agent Guidance
controls.obligation: Priority 4 and TBD controls must not be treated as active enforcement requirements unless documented elsewhere as promoted or implemented.
controls.iac_check: Not checkable from Terraform plan JSON because promotion and implementation status are governance-state decisions outside the plan.
